title: The frontend ends its review page with a 'Now submit your notification' heading and a sentence explaining the button; DR1 ends with the Continue button and nothing else.

finding.frontend: Below the last card the page prints an h2 'Now submit your notification' and the sentence 'Continue to the declaration to submit your notification.' before the Continue button. All three strings are in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:109-113 and are rendered unconditionally at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/template.njk:108-114.
finding.prototype: The last card is followed directly by the Continue button, with no heading and no explanatory sentence (app/views/review-notification.html:181-187). The button's own label is the whole of the instruction.
finding.difference: Delete the submit heading and body from the check-answers copy and from the template, leaving the Continue button on its own. One copy entry and three template lines in each language.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a heading or an explanatory sentence above the Continue button on the DR1 review page.
